note_tweet.text:
I just paid $80 for 21 croissants.

In Switzerland, when you go on vacation for at least a week, you have to bring something—usually breakfast—for the whole team (yes, no joke, it’s an unwritten rule).

And we’re now paying almost $10 a gallon for gas.

Swiss quirks—and there’s no inflation?

Good Lord.
